reason: I want one person to run the whole flat job so I am not chasing a crew, and this could be that. But the offer says nothing about how builders are checked, so I would be handing my flat and my money to strangers picked by a website.
objection: Who checks that the builder is any good? If the platform does not vet them and stand behind the work, it is just a directory with a payment step.
would_change_my_mind: A clear answer on builder vetting, plus a guarantee that the platform holds my payment until the work is signed off and fixes it if the builder fails.
